title_zh: 决定先缩减阅览室采购以补预算缺口

scenario.label_zh: 为阅览室经费缺口选择预算方案
scenario.goal_zh: 确认阅览室预算缺口，并决定保留开放时间、推迟家具采购

context_zh: 社区阅览室的两名筹备者核对本年度预算。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: We have a deficit of six hundred pounds in the reading-room budget.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Could our main donor cover it?

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Perhaps, but our dependence on one person is already worrying. What could we postpone?

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: The new armchairs. The existing chairs are usable, and postponing that purchase would save six hundred.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Would we still have enough to keep the room open on Saturdays?

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Yes. The volunteer rota and heating costs are covered.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: Then let us keep the Saturday opening and delay the armchairs.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Agreed. I will update the budget on that basis.
